definitions.full: H1646. gerushah [ גְּרוּשָׁה ] noun feminine expulsion, violence . Only plural suffix גְּרֻשֹׁתֵיכֶם Ezek 45:9 your acts of expulsion (compare Ew Da; ' Raubereien ' Sm Co).
